prompt: Wide 2D pixel-art background for a side-scrolling game: one long continuous cut-away cross-section of the top floor (the towers) of a medieval stone castle, seen perfectly straight on like a dollhouse with the front wall removed, no perspective, no isometric angle, flat back wall, flat stone floor running straight across the bottom, flat ceiling beam across the top. Light from the upper left, crisp pixels, cosy 16-bit RPG palette.
